d.d: A small enclosed structure, often freestanding, open on one side or with a window, used as a booth to sell newspapers, cigarettes, etc.
A similar but unattended stand for the automatic dispensing of tickets, etc; an e-kiosk.
A member of an indigenous people of North America, currently in Oklahoma.
A language of the Kiowa-Tanoan language family.
An unincorporated community in Glacier County, Montana.
